defect.summary: src/main.js declared `let current = null` and the router ran `current?.unmount` on view change, but `current` was never assigned, so game views' unmount() -> player.stop() cleanup was dead code; exiting a game mid-clip left audio and the 50ms poll running (playback spec 'Volume Control and Cleanup').
defect.contradicted_requirement: playback spec — Requirement: Volume Control and Cleanup (game exit stops audio and polling)

fix.primary_fix: Route defs for the three game views now carry `game: <module>`; route() assigns `current = def.game ?? null` after render, wiring the existing `current?.unmount` lifecycle so every mounted view's cleanup (player.stop() for games 1/3, handle=null for game 2) runs on route change.
fix.bounded_hardening: Prime race guard (games 1 & 3): the prime promise is stored on the round (`round.priming`); the Play click awaits an in-flight prime before playing instead of silently dropping the tap. No new state machine; failed primes still degrade to a no-op.
fix.out_of_scope: No spec/design/tasks edits, no refactors, no style churn, no git commits.

evidence.candidate_state: current is assigned on every route render, so game unmount cleanup is live (audio + poll stop on exit); Play before prime completion waits for the in-flight prime within transient user activation and then plays, or degrades to a no-op on failed prime without new state. Pre-existing, out-of-scope note: album-game revealTracklist late callback could throw after unmount if the user navigates away mid-fetch — not introduced by this remediation, left untouched.
